notes.title: Sale Information (10/31/2024 - 11/14/2024)
notes.content:
We have set up a sale. Details are as follows

Period: 10/31/2024 (Thu) - 11/14/2024 (Thu)
Discount rate: 30

We know that this is the time of year when we tend to miss people.
We would be happy if we could be of help to alleviate your loneliness.

notes.title: The game will be released around 5 PM on July 26th
notes.content:
Our new title, "Yorisoi Delivery", is set to be released around 5 PM on July 26th.

We would be delighted if you could take an hour to play it on a night when you can stay up late.

Thank you very much for your support.
